mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xiaomi.employee ( name, gender, phone, email, birth_date, hire_date, manager_id, position_id, status, gmt_created, gmt_modify ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{birthDate}, #{hireDate}, #{managerId}, #{positionId}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE xiaomi.employee SET name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, manager_id = #{managerId}, position_id = #{positionId}, status = #{status}, gmt_modify = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, gender, phone, email, birth_date, hire_date, manager_id, position_id, status, gmt_created, gmt_modify FROM xiaomi.employee WHERE id = #{id}
